name: Git MCP
tagline: Git operations from chat — commit, diff, log, branch.
shortDescription: A reference MCP server for local Git operations. Your agent can read logs, diff changes, create branches, commit, and stash — without shelling out manually.
longDescription:
## What it does

Exposes common Git operations as MCP tools. Read commit history, view diffs, list branches, create new branches, stage and commit changes, manage stashes.

## Why we recommend it

It removes the "OK, now run this in your terminal" back-and-forth. Your agent can inspect history, propose a change, commit it, and verify the result — all in one chat turn.

## What it does NOT do

This is local-only. It does not push to GitHub, open PRs, or sync with remotes. Pair it with the GitHub MCP server for the full workflow.
installInstructions:
1. Run the install command from inside a Git repository (or pass `--repository /path/to/repo`)
2. The server uses the local `git` CLI; make sure Git is installed
3. For SSH remotes, ensure your SSH agent is running
